-- SmoothFourierData.lean

/-- The genuine first coordinate derivative. -/
noncomputable def partialX (f : Plane → ℂ) (z : Plane) : ℂ := fderiv ℝ f z (1, 0)

noncomputable def xJet (p : ℕ) (f : Plane → ℂ) : Plane → ℂ := partialX^[p] f

-- TorusInverse.lean
def derivativeWord : List Bool → (Plane → ℂ) → Plane → ℂ
  | [], f => f
  | j :: js, f => coordinatePartial j (derivativeWord js f)

-- ParametricTorusInverse.lean
noncomputable def mixedLossConstant (r : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ((6 * ‖omega⁻¹‖) * ‖omega‖ ^ r) * 3 ^ (r + 5) *
    ∑' k : Frequency, (weight k ^ 4)⁻¹

-- SmoothFamilyTorusInverse.lean (statement only; proof omitted, already kernel-checked)
theorem norm_derivativeWord_inverse_le (d : Direction) {f : Source P}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hp : Periodic f) (w : List Bool) (p : P) (Y : Plane) {C : ℝ}
    (hzero : ∀ x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖f (p, (x, y))‖ ≤ C)
    (hfirst : ∀ x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ‖SmoothFourierData.xJet (w.length + 5) (slice f p) (x, y)‖ ≤ C)
    (hsecond : ∀ x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ‖SmoothFourierData.xJet (w.length + 5)
        (SmoothFourierData.swapFunction (slice f p)) (x, y)‖ ≤ C) :
    ‖derivativeWord w (slice (inverse d f) p) Y‖ ≤
      ParametricTorusInverse.mixedLossConstant w.length * C := by

ground_truth.label: Lean needs m+5 derivatives of F where the paper's (8.19) uses m+4 (C^{m+4} norm)
Lean bounds one derivative word w at a time; (8.19) is a C^m norm, i.e. a sup over all multi-indices of order <= m
